integrity: Same-model proof and literature assessment completed; numerical checks supplement rather than establish the analytic statements. No external audit or independent validation was performed. Publication-priority risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Applies to real W^{k,1}(R^2), every integer k>=1, the unweighted sum of all mixed weak derivative L1 norms, and affine planar shears. The sharpness uses the previously proved Ornstein non-inequality. No complete classification of all higher-degree phase transitions, nonlinear changes of variables, or bounded-domain analogue is claimed.
title: Exact shear distortion and two endpoint-Sobolev norm transitions
